reason: I've been burned by bots giving wrong answers in front of customers, and I'd rather not put a third party's AI on my site. I'd probably try the free plan at most, and I could wire up something similar with an LLM API in a weekend.
objection: A wrong or made-up answer in front of a customer costs me far more than 49 EUR a month. A cute mascot doesn't tell me how it avoids hallucinating, and the confirm-before-submit step doesn't fix a bad answer.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews on G2 or Capterra from SaaS teams like mine, plus a test on my own docs where it shows sources and says 'I don't know' instead of guessing, with a measured lift on the free plan.
